description.title: אדירה כסף - כיסויים
description.summary: This table details the covered risks under the Adira Silver apartment insurance policy. It lists specific events, such as fire or theft, that the insurance covers.
description.embed_passage: פוליסת אדירה כסף מציעה כיסוי לנזקים שנגרמו כתוצאה משריפה, ברקים, רוחות חזקות מעל 30 קשר, או פגיעה של כלי רכב בדירה. הכיסוי כולל גם נזקים כתוצאה מפעולות זדון, למעט מקרים בהם הדירה אינה מאוישת. הפוליסה מכסה גם רעידות אדמה וגלי צונאמי הנגרמים מרעידות אדמה.

sketch:
1.1 Fire, lightning, thunder and smoke constituting an extraordinary and nonpermanent phenomenon.
1.2 Explosion or combustion.
1.3 Winds exceeding 30 knots, including rain falling at the same time, snow or hail, except for leakage of rainwater through walls or ceilings or absorption thereof.
1.4 Falling aircraft, falling objects from aircraft, supersonic vibration caused by aircraft.
1.5 Contact or collision of a vehicle with the apartment.

טבלה: אדירה כסף - כיסויים
This table details the covered risks under the Adira Silver apartment insurance policy. It lists specific events, such as fire or theft, that the insurance covers.
ממדים: Covered risk/event, Description of the covered event

1.1 Fire, lightning, thunder and smoke constituting an extraordinary and nonpermanent phenomenon.
1.2 Explosion or combustion.
1.3 Winds exceeding 30 knots, including rain falling at the same time, snow or hail, except for leakage of rainwater through walls or ceilings or absorption thereof.
1.4 Falling aircraft, falling objects from aircraft, supersonic vibration caused by aircraft.
1.5 Contact or collision of a vehicle with the apartment.
